name: New Capenna
description: New Capenna is a city plane whose levels include the Mezzio and the lowest level, the Caldaia.

summary.text: New Capenna is a city plane whose levels include the Mezzio and the lowest level, the Caldaia.

bio.text: The Mezzio is one of the three levels of the city, and the Caldaia is the lowest.
R suggested dancing there after meeting Huatli at Iveta's Tavern.

status.text: The material's events and relations only describe its levels and a suggested dance outing, so nothing more of its state is recorded.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
timeline.quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

timeline.summary: Perrie heads off to a street fight with the Obscura, carrying the boy's cap.
timeline.quote: Perrie looks down at the cap in his hand thoughtfully.

timeline.summary: The Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane at the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Here's to taking over the plane."

timeline.summary: Tivit is gripped by a prophecy of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae, gold in the water and halos, as Kamiz and Queza visit.
timeline.quote: "The kitten hiding the cream . . . Corvidae, flitting and pecking . . . Gold in the water . . . Hiding the cream, the kitten!"

timeline.summary: Seers across New Capenna report the same vision at the same time.
timeline.quote: All reporting the same thing.

timeline.summary: Denry Klin tells Kamiz and Queza that Lacey is probably out with Lagrella the Magpie.
timeline.quote: "One of those straightlaced Brokers. Lagrita or something."

timeline.summary: Lacey is found in a dumpster with her mind wiped.
timeline.quote: Found her sitting in a dumpster in a stupor. Mind wiped."

timeline.summary: Tivit's shop is set aflame and its balcony collapses; Kamiz rescues Tivit but Queza appears crushed before emerging unharmed.
timeline.quote: Kamiz projected her magic forward, gripping Tivit's thick fur and Queza's long coat

timeline.summary: Kamiz foils a Broker agent's contract on Tivit with a mirror and learns the Riveteers smashed a new halo stained glass.
timeline.quote: The binding magic reflected to the agent and fizzled.

timeline.summary: Queza finds halos in the buildings where visions occurred and says it is a message from the angels; Kamiz scolds her and removes her from the case.
timeline.quote: "You're off this case."

timeline.summary: Kamiz confronts Lagrella in an illusory Mergino Fountain, and Lagrella reveals the Prophecy and that the Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The Cabaretti figured out how to make Halo.

timeline.summary: Queza and Kamiz trap Lagrella with a mirror, forcing her to nullify Lacey's contract, which restores Lacey's memory.
timeline.quote: Lagrella's signature cracked the paper in two.

timeline.summary: Kamiz admits Queza was right and returns her talisman and sigils, saying maybe she does not know everything.
timeline.quote: "Ridiculous. But maybe . . . maybe I don't know everything."

timeline.summary: Elspeth tails a Maestros informant across rooftops to a door in a shadowed alcove.
timeline.quote: The vampire knocked on the door and waited.

timeline.summary: Raccoonfolk ambush Elspeth in an alley and she bowls them over.
timeline.quote: she spun and used him like a battering ram to bowl over the others.

timeline.summary: Dressed in Xander's tailored outfit, Elspeth visits a Cabaretti cabaret looking for work and is rebuffed by the bartender Rocco.
timeline.quote: Rocco gave her a look that said, Who do you think you are? and promptly walked away.

timeline.summary: Kitt Kanto takes Elspeth to Jinnie, who agrees to give her a few small jobs for the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Then I think I have a few small jobs for you.

timeline.summary: Vivien follows Tezzeret down through the girders beneath New Capenna, wary of him but trusting her gut.
timeline.quote: Vivien trusted her gut and followed him deeper into the underbelly of this strange, new plane.

timeline.summary: At the bottom of the city Vivien notices the ruins of the first Capenna, with claw marks gouged into the stone.
timeline.quote: These ruins must have been the first Capenna.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
timeline.quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
timeline.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is playing both sides: he needs what Norn promised but does not want life destroyed or himself transformed, and Vivien relaxes.
timeline.quote: He was playing both sides.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
timeline.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

timeline.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
timeline.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

timeline.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
timeline.quote: "You have a deal."

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "She is the key to our success."

timeline.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

timeline.summary: In the alley, Vivien appears and kills the Adversary's goons with spectral wolves; Elspeth vouches for her to Giada.
timeline.quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

timeline.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.
timeline.quote: "Bring Giada to me."

timeline.summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
timeline.quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

timeline.summary: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, Anhelo takes Errant to a rundown neighborhood to buy information from Toluz.
timeline.quote: "Art's everywhere, if you know where to look,"

timeline.summary: Toluz agrees to tell Anhelo about the woman in white only if he kills Fiero Vespin, who has attacked her daughter Parnesse, by tomorrow's wedding.
timeline.quote: "If you want information for your Family, you have to do a little work for ours. Bump him off, and we'll talk,"

timeline.summary: Toluz reveals Fiero plans to use twenty goons to ruin the wedding, and Anhelo accepts the job.
timeline.quote: "Real considerate of you," he said.

timeline.summary: Anhelo sends Fiero an invitation to a private museum tour and asks Evelyn for a favor, agreeing to owe her.
timeline.quote: "All right," he said. "Name your price."

timeline.summary: Running late to the wedding, Anhelo takes a cab driven by a man who locks the doors and takes him on a reckless drive.
timeline.quote: the locks clamped down on the doors.

timeline.summary: The driver reveals he is Severo, whose father Anhelo killed on his birthday three years ago, and drives into oncoming traffic.
timeline.quote: "It's Severo. And three years ago, you killed my father on my birthday,"

timeline.summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
timeline.quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

timeline.summary: Riveteers who own the Halo in the trunk surround the battered Anhelo, who resolves to fight his way to the wedding.
timeline.quote: "You want to dance?" he slurred.

timeline.summary: Toluz appears with the shadow generator's darkness and wipes out the Riveteers, saving Anhelo.
timeline.quote: When it was all over, she was the only one left standing

timeline.summary: Toluz calls Anhelo family and has a healer and a new suit waiting for him in her limo.
timeline.quote: "You're family, Anhelo."

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada shelter in an abandoned warehouse, where Giada confesses her fear that her magic is not enough and Elspeth vows to keep her safe.
timeline.quote: "And I will personally ensure you are safe to take the time you need to do so, however long that is."

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
timeline.quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

timeline.summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
timeline.quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

timeline.summary: Kamiz leads the group through Obscura tunnels toward the Cloud Spire; Giada drops a tracking bracelet and Elspeth destroys it.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ground the bracelet under her boot.

timeline.summary: Huatli proposes meeting at Iveta's Tavern at moonrise, and R accepts and suggests dancing afterward in New Capenna.
timeline.quote: We can meet at Iveta's for round one and planeswalk from there?

timeline.summary: Ashiok's letter recounts how Elspeth and a prisoner called Boy tried to hide among corpses in a Phyrexian asylum on New Capenna; Boy was caught and Phyrexianized.
timeline.quote: Thanks to your Planeswalker spark, you escaped, but Boy wasn't as fortunate.

timeline.summary: Norn tells Atraxa about the Phyrexian ship sealed away by angels on New Capenna and shows her the city.
timeline.quote: Angels. False prophets bound to stone for their insolence,

timeline.summary: Norn orders Atraxa to harvest New Capenna and destroy the wellspring of Halo.
timeline.quote: You will harvest them all.

timeline.summary: Norn reveals a danger to New Phyrexia exists on New Capenna and Theros, which Atraxa and Ajani must seal.
timeline.quote: In killing New Capenna, we strike at her heart.

timeline.summary: Atraxa begins scouring New Capenna, destroying its inhabitants with swarms and gas.
timeline.quote: A single thought from Atraxa summons swarms of flying servitors.

timeline.summary: Atraxa searches the minds of compleated Maestros and learns the word beautiful and museum.
timeline.quote: Searching their minds provides another answer: museum .

timeline.summary: Atraxa beheads stone angel statues outside the cathedral despite the pain of Halo.
timeline.quote: In a blur of white, she strikes the heads from the statues.

timeline.summary: The angel statues, with an unseen visitor, choose not to stop Atraxa, saying it is not yet time.
timeline.quote: It is not yet time.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is told by the voice, now in her mother's likeness, that she must make one more choice about where to intervene as the planes burn.
timeline.quote: You must choose where to intervene,

timeline.summary: Elspeth is shown the Phyrexian assault on New Capenna led by the corrupted angel Atraxa.
timeline.quote: "They call her Atraxa."

timeline.summary: Elspeth finds she cannot affect events as an observer, even as Phyrexian beasts slaughter citizens.
timeline.quote: She tries to save the man only for her hands to fade through him.

timeline.summary: In a dream-memory of her wedding, Errant and Parnesse dance among the Maestros until Phyrexian oil transforms the guests, including her father Anhelo, and Atraxa tears off the roof.
timeline.quote: the roof of the Maestro's museum was ripped clean off

timeline.summary: The Invasion Tree's branches shrivel as angels with Halo are unleashed into the Multiverse through the portals.
timeline.quote: "The angels are being unleashed into the Multiverse, bringing the power of Halo with them."

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a corrupted angel, cuts through New Capenna's defenses while the angels, demons and devils fight her armies.
timeline.quote: She cuts her way through the city's defenses as a farmer threshing wheat.

timeline.summary: With Atraxa dead, the Invasion Tree's barbs retract and the angels see portals open to Theros and decide to go help.
timeline.quote: Atraxa's death has changed New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: In flashback, Yuma and Elnor team up with Shadress and others, leave the Riveteers and try to build a collective in an empty warehouse.
timeline.quote: We would leave the Riveteers, where we'd all spent our youth.

timeline.summary: In flashback, the squat's owner impounds their gear, so the crew turns to crime to pay the back rent.
timeline.quote: So, obviously, it would have to be crime, the main industry in New Capenna.

timeline.summary: In flashback, the crew blows safes and robs trains while Elnor charms guards and clerks.
timeline.quote: we blew safes and teased open vaults, we muscled our way through trains on rickety bridges.

timeline.summary: In flashback, the crew borrows money to buy a building, a decision that leads to layers of debt and enemies.
timeline.quote: We borrowed the money to buy it.

timeline.summary: Yuma runs off down the Omenpaths, abandoning his friends and taking the money.
timeline.quote: Just ran off down the Omenpaths, not knowing where I was going.

timeline.summary: Eula's father hands her a letter that has arrived for her, opened, by omenpath courier.
timeline.quote: "Eula," says her father, lowering the letter. "This came for you."

timeline.summary: Eula learns the letter is an invitation to Strixhaven on Arcavios with tuition and supplies covered and an omenpath ticket.
timeline.quote: "A place called Strixhaven, on a plane called Arcavios. They teach wizards there."

timeline.summary: Eula's father questions whether she still wants to be a Broker and she lies that she does.
timeline.quote: "Yes, sir," she lies.

timeline.summary: Eula's father tells her to go to Strixhaven, learn everything and bring it back to New Capenna and to the Family.
timeline.quote: You'll learn everything they have to teach you, and everything they don't intend to teach you

timeline.summary: Eula's mother tells her she leaves tomorrow and they begin to pack.
timeline.quote: "You leave tomorrow," her mother says

timeline.summary: Angels burn the demonic contract out of Ob Nixilis and he vows to serve them.
timeline.quote: The angels there burned the contract out of him, and, in gratitude, Ob Nixilis vowed to serve them.

relations.note: One of the three levels of the city.
relations.quote: Of the three levels of New Capenna, the Mezzio was Vivien's least favorite.

relations.note: The Caldaia is the lowest level of New Capenna.
relations.quote: the Caldaia, the lowest level of New Capenna

pages_say.description: A city of steel and gilded lines, ruled by five families, shielded by an ancient barrier from a ruined plane.
A city perched on girders over the old plane, run by the crime families.
A domed city of five families where Elspeth seeks home.
The city where the visions spread.
The city founded by a pact between angels and demons.
A plane dominated by a vertical industrial city with three levels (the Caldaia, the Mezzio and Park Heights), ruled by competing crime families and built atop the ruins of an older Capenna.
The plane of the city-wide crime families, where the Crescendo takes place.
The plane with competing crime families.
The city plane of crime families, subways and Halo.
The city plane, in the throes of inter-family war.
A plane that R recommends visiting for its dance hall in Park Heights.
The plane where Elspeth suffered, with a Phyrexian asylum.
A plane Elspeth thinks of as lost.
A golden plane shrouded in Halo where angels once sealed away a Phyrexian ship.
A towering city plane scoured by Atraxa's forces.
A fortified city plane whose Park Heights is attacked by Phyrexians under Atraxa.
The art-deco city plane overrun by the Phyrexian invasion.
The city plane where the angels have held off Phyrexia and where Atraxa is killed.
The ruined, crime-ridden city plane that Yuma and Elnor come from.
A city-plane ruled by five Families that was devastated by the Phyrexian Invasion.
The plane where Stella Lee has a buyer for Arcavios artifacts.
A plane where angels burned the contract out of Ob Nixilis.
